//: Worked example for `vlmkit gates`. Copy to your repo root as vlmkit.gates.json. Docs: docs/cli-reference.md#gates-config
//webServer: Optional. Starts a dev server before `gates run` and stops it after, including on Ctrl-C -- so a config with URL sources is committable on its own instead of needing a shell wrapper that does start / trap kill / poll-for-ready. Shaped after Playwright's. `url` is required and polled until it answers (any HTTP status counts), so "started" means "serving". `reuseExistingServer` defaults to true locally and false under CI: locally the listening port is your own dev server, in CI it is usually a leak from an earlier job.

defaults.//: Gates every page gets unless it overrides `gates`. `extraGates` adds on top.
defaults.//rules: Rule-granular settings, checked against each gate's declared rule table (`vlmkit rules <gate>`). off|suspect|warn|info. Unlike a suppression, this needs no per-gate flag to exist and a typo is a config error. Two forms: the bare setting, or an object with `reason` (required) plus optional `owner`/`expires`. The long form is enumerated by `vlmkit gates suppressions` and an expired one is DROPPED, so the rule fails again -- the same contract suppressions have always had. Reach for it whenever the answer is "the tool is wrong here" rather than "this rule is not for us".

check.integrity/low-contrast-text.reason: Brand grey on white is 4.1:1; legal signed the contrast exception for body copy pending the 2027 palette refresh.

defaults.//suppressions: Default-scope suppressions apply to every page. Use sparingly — a repo-wide exemption is the hardest kind to revisit.

suppressions.reason: Every page carries the same sr-only skip link; the manifest lists it because legal reviews the wording.

pages.//: A glob expands to one entry per file; ids become `docs:routes/docs/a.html` so --only docs still selects the group.
pages.//rules: Page rules merge over defaults.rules, key by key -- including the reason, so a page that restates a rule restates why.

check.integrity/near-misalignment.reason: Generated API pages carry near-miss alignment from the doc generator's table layout; nothing else about integrity is relaxed here.

suppressions.//: Named per instance, not thresholded: reuse is instances/styles, an AVERAGE, so a small role with one deliberate variant sits below any threshold that is not 1. Copy the selector exactly as the finding prints it.
suppressions.flag: --allow "button.tile--stripe;provider tiles carry provider branding by requirement"
suppressions.reason: Payment-method tiles are deliberately styled per provider (brand requirement), so button styles do not consolidate here.

suppressions.//: An integrity exemption. The reason inside --allow explains the pattern; the reason here explains the approval. Both are printed.
suppressions.flag: --allow "near-misalignment@.provider-badge;provider logos are optically centred, not edge-aligned"
suppressions.reason: Optical centring signed off with design; the 2px probe cannot express it.
